title: Identity & Belonging
intro: The teenage years ask a harder version of the same question, and they ask it in public. Who am I, who decides, and where do I actually belong? The answers on offer are image, comparison and approval, and all three run out. This month we say the older, steadier thing — your worth was settled before you achieved anything, and belonging is not the same as fitting in.

keyScriptures.text: People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.
Being rooted and established in love.

weeks.title: You Are Not Your Image
weeks.declaration: You are not the version of you that other people scroll past, rate or repeat. You were made deliberately, by someone who was not guessing, and your worth was settled before you achieved a thing.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, in a world that measures our child constantly, tell them the truth about themselves louder than the noise does. Amen.

weeks.title: Belonging Is Not Fitting In
weeks.declaration: Fitting in asks you to become smaller. Belonging lets you arrive whole. You do not have to audition for a place you have already been given.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, give our child at least one place — this home first — where they never have to perform to be welcome. Amen.

weeks.title: Kept Through the Changing
weeks.declaration: You are changing fast, and you are kept through all of it. One bad day does not get to name you, and comparison does not get the last word.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, steady our child through everything that is changing in them. Where we would rush them, make us patient. Amen.

weeks.title: Rooted in Love
weeks.declaration: You are being rooted in a love that has no season, so that when opinions blow through, you are not moved by every one of them. Before you know what you will do, you know whose you are.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, root this one so deeply in Your love that no crowd can move them. Let them leave our house knowing whose they are. Amen.

days.title: You Are Not Your Image
days.declaration: You are not the version of you that other people scroll past. You are the one God knows, and He is not looking at the picture.

scripture.text: People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.

days.title: Worth You Did Not Earn
days.declaration: Your worth was settled before you achieved anything, so nothing you achieve can raise it and nothing you fail can lower it.

scripture.text: It is by grace you have been saved, through faith — not by works.

days.title: Made, Not Assembled
days.declaration: You were made, deliberately, by someone who wanted a person exactly like you to exist. You are not a set of parts other people rate.

scripture.text: I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful.

days.title: Belonging Is Not Fitting In
days.declaration: Fitting in asks you to become smaller. Belonging lets you arrive whole. You already belong, so you do not have to shrink to be let in.

scripture.text: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you.

days.title: Approved Already
days.declaration: You do not have to audition. God's approval of you is not a decision He is still making.

scripture.text: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God?

days.title: Chosen Before You Knew
days.declaration: You were chosen before you knew there was a choice being made — not because of what you would become, but because you were wanted.

scripture.text: You did not choose me, but I chose you.

days.title: Named
days.declaration: You have been called by name. Whatever names you have been given at school or online, this is the one that holds.

scripture.text: Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name; you are mine.

days.title: Comparison Is a Thief
days.declaration: Comparison will tell you that you are behind. It is lying. You are not late, and you are not competing.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions... without comparing themselves to someone else.

days.title: Not Defined by a Bad Day
days.declaration: One bad day does not get to name you. You are more than the worst thing you did this week.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Fear of People
days.declaration: The fear of what people think is a trap you can walk out of. God's opinion of you is settled, and it is kind.

scripture.text: Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is kept safe.

days.title: Hidden and Safe
days.declaration: Your life is hidden with Christ. There is a part of you nobody at school gets a vote on.

scripture.text: Your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

days.title: A New Creation
days.declaration: You are a new creation. You are not stuck being who you were at thirteen, or last year, or last week.

scripture.text: If anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come.

days.title: Loved at Your Least Impressive
days.declaration: You are loved at your least impressive. That is the only kind of love strong enough to build a life on.

scripture.text: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

days.title: Not an Accident
days.declaration: Your life is not a coincidence of timing. You were placed in this generation on purpose.

scripture.text: He marked out their appointed times in history and the boundaries of their lands.

days.title: Free
days.declaration: You are free. Not free from everything hard, but free from having to prove you are worth keeping.

scripture.text: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.

days.title: Kept Through Change
days.declaration: You are changing fast, and you are kept through all of it. God is not confused by who you are becoming.

scripture.text: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.

days.title: Your Days Are Written
days.declaration: Your days were written before one of them happened. You do not have to have your whole life figured out tonight.

scripture.text: All the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.

days.title: Not Too Much
days.declaration: You are not too much. Your feelings, your questions, your intensity — none of it makes God want to hand you back.

scripture.text: Pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge.

days.title: Not Too Little
days.declaration: You are not too little either. Being quiet is not the same as being unimportant.

scripture.text: Those parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable.

days.title: Belonging Without Performing
days.declaration: In this family you do not have to perform to be welcome. Come home tired, come home wrong, come home anyway.

scripture.text: While he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion.

days.title: Engraved
days.declaration: You are not forgettable. God says He has engraved you where He cannot look away.

scripture.text: See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.

days.title: An Heir
days.declaration: You are not staff in God's house. You are family, with everything that comes with it.

scripture.text: If we are children, then we are heirs — heirs of God.

days.title: Your Body Is Not the Verdict
days.declaration: Your body is not a verdict on your worth. It is a gift you live in, and it is honoured by God.

scripture.text: You are not your own; you were bought at a price. Therefore honour God with your bodies.

days.title: Loved with an Everlasting Love
days.declaration: This love does not have a season. It has been coming toward you your whole life and it has not slowed down.

scripture.text: I have loved you with an everlasting love.

days.title: Rooted
days.declaration: You are being rooted in love, so that when opinions blow through, you are not moved by every one of them.

scripture.text: Being rooted and established in love.

days.title: Called Friend
days.declaration: God calls you a friend. He is not distant, and He is not disappointed you turned up.

scripture.text: I no longer call you servants... I have called you friends.

days.title: Held Together
days.declaration: When you feel like you are coming apart, He is holding you together. That is not your job tonight.

scripture.text: In him all things hold together.

days.title: Not Alone
days.declaration: You are not the only one. God sets the lonely in families, and He is doing it for you too.

scripture.text: God sets the lonely in families.

days.title: Your Portion
days.declaration: God Himself is your portion — the part of your life that cannot be taken by anyone's opinion.

scripture.text: Lord, you alone are my portion; the boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places.

days.title: Delighted In
days.declaration: He does not merely tolerate you. He delights in you, and He is glad you exist.

scripture.text: He will rejoice over you with singing.

days.title: Whose You Are
days.declaration: Before you know what you will do, you know whose you are. Carry that into everything this year asks of you.

scripture.text: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God!
